content.body:
A draft item body can be long.
It can run for many lines.
The Roadmap must never carry it.
This line exists only to make the body long enough to notice if it leaks.
It also has a heading.

## Notes

A draft item holds the owner's sequencing notes, not roadmap fields.
The body can mention a milestone title and a date without those becoming roadmap fields.
It can quote a status such as In progress.
It can name a repository such as trajectonomics/cli.
None of that may reach the projection.
The row is kept because it is a DraftIssue, not because of its body.
Its title is safe because only someone with write access to the Project can create a draft.
